prerequisites.title: Security documentation
prerequisites.detail: Provide current audits (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 with SOA or PCI DSS), penetration test reports and security policies. Without a formal audit you must describe controls such as MFA, encryption and background checks.

prerequisites.title: Security and incident contacts
prerequisites.detail: Name, title and email for a security contact and an incident response contact.

prerequisites.title: Your own Gusto client ID and secret
prerequisites.detail: Gusto generates the id and secret when you supply a redirect URI. Composio has no managed Gusto app.

steps.title: Register demo app with redirect URI
steps.detail: Supply a redirect URI to Gusto so it generates your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard, or use a proxy on your own domain.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret for the demo app.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists for the gusto toolkit.

steps.title: Test assigned scopes in demo
steps.detail: Run your agent's calls in the demo environment against the scopes Gusto assigns.
steps.done_when: All needed calls work in demo.

steps.title: Prepare security evidence pack
steps.detail: Draft the security control answers and collect policies and reports for review.
steps.done_when: Pack is complete and ready to submit.

steps.title: Submit Production Pre-Approval
steps.detail: Submit the application and respond promptly to any extra information requests.

steps.title: Wait for pre-approval and Security Review
steps.detail: Partnerships reviews first; GRC then starts the Security Review. No timeline is documented.

traps.title: Rate limit violations are measured over a rolling 60-second
traps.detail: Rate limit violations are measured over a rolling 60-second window per OAuth grant, so up to 200 requests are allowed in any 60 seconds for each grant's access_token.

traps.title: Review pauses until you respond
traps.detail: Gusto may ask for more information, and the Security Review is on hold until you answer.

traps.title: Scopes are enforced only in production
traps.detail: Calls outside assigned scopes are rejected in production. Extra scopes require emailing Gusto after release.

traps.title: Production redirect changes need Gusto
traps.detail: Demo redirects are self-service, but changing the production redirect requires emailing Gusto. Wildcards and fragments are not allowed.

traps.title: One OAuth grant per company
traps.detail: Since v2023-05-01, multi-company admins must run OAuth once per company.

traps.title: Rate limit per connected user
traps.detail: 200 requests per minute per user; extra calls get HTTP 429.

blockers.what_it_means: Gusto requested more information and paused the review.
You must provide detailed control information instead.
blockers.what_to_do: Document background checks, MFA, access control, encryption, vulnerability management and data retention.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the control descriptions from your policies.

open_questions: How long do Production Pre-Approval and Security Review take? Ask Gusto's Partnerships team.

Is there a Composio credential guide for Gusto? None found; check Composio support.
